symptom: alter page … set (Caption: 'New caption') on myGrid column('Old caption') failed in check and exec with "column myGrid column('Old caption') not found … available: …, myGrid column('New caption')".
cause: applySetPropertyMutator re-resolves the column after the SET (hidden-property reset, and per-property application). #1644 moved Attribute last for an attribute address; a caption address had the same hazard with Caption, which was applied first and moved the column away from its own address.
fix: The property written last is the one the address reads: Caption when the target is column('…'), Attribute otherwise.
insight: When an address is a property value, any SET of that property invalidates the address for every later step in the same statement. Grep for the earlier fix of the sibling property (#1644) — it had generalised the mechanism but hard-coded one property.
test: mdl/executor/alter_set_column_caption_2146_test.go (PedApp; caption alone, caption + Visible, control: attribute-addressed rename); reverted: column … not found
